headline: Brazilian Real and Stocks Suffer Sharp Correction After Presidential Election
summary: The recent presidential election in Brazil triggered a sharp adjustment in local financial markets, reversing pre-runoff optimism and refocusing attention on fiscal signals.
why: Political shifts in Latin America's largest economy heavily impact macroeconomic stability, investor risk appetite, and local asset valuations.

impacts.name: Brazilian Real
impacts.why: Election outcomes perceived as unfavorable for fiscal discipline can trigger immediate capital outflows and currency depreciation.

why_moved: Uncertainty surrounding future fiscal policy following the presidential election caused investors to reprice sovereign risk, driving a sharp selloff in domestic equities and the currency.
